name: savrion-workspace
description: Savrion Software Solutions Website & Admin Panel

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,WEBSITE,ADMIN" -c "blue,cyan,green" "npm run dev --prefix admin-panel/backend" "npm run dev --prefix savrion-website" "npm run dev --prefix admin-panel/frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix savrion-website && npm install --prefix admin-panel/frontend && npm install --prefix admin-panel/backend
scripts.build:all: npm run build:website && npm run build:admin
scripts.deploy: npm run build:all && firebase deploy --only hosting:website,hosting:admin
